body:
WHAT
Every token quantity the app uses — window size (inputTokensOf), per-class sums (addUsage), estimates (estimateTokens with CHARS_PER_TOKEN 3.5), display rounding (formatTokens), occupancy (contextPercentOf) and free space (freeContextOf) — is defined once in engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts and mirrored for the renderer in app/renderer/modules/tokens.js. Core, providers and the frontend import these instead of re-deriving them.

WHY
Two surfaces computing 'tokens' independently drift and disagree (the renderer once had its own pricing copy that drifted), making the meter, the report and compaction contradict each other.

WHERE
engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts — emptyUsage(), addUsage(), inputTokensOf(), CHARS_PER_TOKEN, estimateTokens(), formatTokens(), contextPercentOf(), freeContextOf(); Usage type in engine/protocol/src/types.ts. Consumers: engine/core/src/runtime/sessionStats.ts (imports all from @magentra/protocol), engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts (estimateTokens, addUsage, inputTokensOf, CHARS_PER_TOKEN, formatTokens), engine/providers/src/*.ts (emptyUsage). Mirror: app/renderer/modules/tokens.js (same CHARS_PER_TOKEN and formatTokens bands).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. formatTokens: 999 → '999', 1000 → '1.0k', 9949 → '9.9k', 9950 → '10k', 210000 → '210k', 999500 → '1.0M'; negative input renders as '0'.
2. estimateTokens('abcdefg') (7 chars) returns 2 (ceil(7/3.5)); estimateTokens(-5) returns 0.
3. contextPercentOf(50, 0) returns 0 (never NaN/Infinity); freeContextOf(100, 80, 30) returns 0 (clamped), freeContextOf(100, 40) returns 60.
4. addUsage mutates and returns its target with all four classes summed separately; emptyUsage() has all four fields 0.
5. Static check: no file under engine/core/src, engine/providers/src or app/renderer/modules defines its own characters-per-token constant or a second k/M formatting function other than tokens.ts and its renderer mirror (grep for '3.5' / 'toFixed(1)}M' outside those two files finds nothing).
